summary.text: Trojan father of Laogonus and Dardanus, sons twain whom Achilles thrust from their chariot to the ground in the rout — distinct from the Pylian shepherd (`bias-pylian`), the Aeolid (`bias-aeolid`), the Athenian captain (`bias-athenian`), and the Dulichian suitor (`bias-dulichium`).

story.text: Then setting upon Laogonus and Dardanus, sons twain of Bias, Achilles thrust them both from their chariot to the ground, smiting the one with a cast of his spear and the other with his sword in close fight.
Apollodorus counts Bias among the many sons whom Priam begot by other women, in the long roll beside Dryops, Lycaon, and Chromius.
